text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Satsuki Sho just around the 
corner, she seemed fully prepared―― or so 
it appeared, but Admire Vega had lost her 
appetite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fighting spirit directed at them by 
Narita Top Road the other day flashes 
across their mind. Could it be that 
they're getting impatient?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan encouraged Admire Vega, 
telling her to eat well and give it her 
all since it was a race against an 
"unbeatable rival."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—A "rival she cannot lose to"? Not "just 
one of the opponents to defeat for her 
mission"? Once again, a feeling of 
dissonance arises within Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still without a clear answer... the day of 
the Satsuki Sho arrived, where she would 
compete for victory against T.M. Opera O 
and Narita Top Road.
